units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 59a">Kidd. 59ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="E00740"><he>הָפַךְ</he></cite> (v. also Rashi a. l. a. infra).
<cite ref="Tosefta Chagigah 3:12">Tosef. Ḥag. III, 12</cite>; Y. ib. III, 79ᵇ, v. <cite ref="V00348"><he>תָּחַב</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 2:3">B. Kam. II, 3</cite> <he>שנטל ח׳</he> that took a cake (with live coals sticking to it).—Pl. <he>חֲרָרִין</he>.
Bets. II, 6 (21ᵇ) גריצין וח׳ Bab. ed., v. גְּרִיצָה (Mish. ed. חוֹרִי, Y. ed. חֹרִי b. h., collect. noun: cakes); Y. ib. 61ᶜ bot. (play on חֳרִי, Deut. XXIX, 23, a. on חֹרִי, Gen. XL, 16).

senses.gloss: pile of sheaves, temporary stack in the field.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 5:8">Peah V, 8</cite> <he>לח׳</he> for the purpose of temporary piling, opp. <he>לגוֹרֶן</he>. [<cite ref="Kiddushin 59a:6">Kidd. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>עני המהפך בח׳</he> a poor man moving about a stack (waiting for its removal to take up eventually a forgotten sheaf); cmp. Peah l. c.; oth. defin. v. <cite ref="E00740"><he>הָפַךְ</he></cite>.]—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 5:7:1">Y. Peah V, end, 19ᵃ</cite>, expl. <he>ח׳</he> with <cite ref="C00871"><he>גַּלְגַּל</he></cite> a globular heap.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 11:3">Kel. XI, 3</cite> he who makes vessels <he>מן הח׳</he> of iron ore (before it is smelted).
